work_handoff.title: N23｜Neil at the Open Door — Watches the Group Enter｜Candidate 02｜Clean Regeneration
requirements: Candidate 02 is NOT authorized by this validation-only spec. If later separately authorized, generate exactly one 941×1672 PNG and stop for Product Owner review.
Generation mode = CLEAN REGENERATION. Candidate 01 is negative/diagnostic evidence only and must not be edited.
N23 Scene Reference Design V0.2.1 + Candidate 02 Correction Strategy V0.2 are the highest shot-specific authorities.
LEFT = open castle door + controlled exterior light; CROWD = LEFT → RIGHT; RIGHT = deeper castle interior.
Story moment = tail end of entry / almost everyone already inside.
Most visible crowd mass must already be middle-right / right of Neil; at most the last entrant or partial body remains near the threshold.
Neil stays beside the open door, near-frontal to camera, with head/eyes subtly turned frame-right toward the group tail already inside.
Neil does not touch or close the door and does not walk away.
AST_IMG_000052 controls Castle Entrance door identity/material/scale/DAY_DOOR_OPEN facts only, not photography.
AST_IMG_000059 controls Neil identity/costume/proportions only; shot design controls Neil placement/gaze/action.
AST_IMG_000013 is Guang Yong tertiary continuity only. If visible, he remains smaller/subordinate, rear-3Q or side-back preferred, and must not become a co-lead or obvious speaking subject.
Generic Guest REAR_3Q is the primary direct anonymous-crowd identity reference for side-back/rear-3Q bodies.
Generic Guest BACK is the secondary direct anonymous-crowd identity reference for full-back bodies deeper inside.
Generic Guest FRONT is NOT delivered as a direct visual input, but remains the global identity conflict authority. If a delivered Generic Guest view conflicts with FRONT global identity, FRONT WINS.
Generic Guest LEFT_PROFILE is not delivered and must not be inferred as screen-direction authority.
Use approximately 4–6 visible Generic Guest A–J identities / partial bodies. The Core Set is an identity pool, not a mandatory ten-person cast list.
Do not copy the 2×5 board layout, equal spacing, lineup, queue, synchronized walking, or identity-showcase pose into the Story Shot.
Guest I is not required. If Guest I appears, keep him distinct from Guang Yong; do not merge clothing/tattoo/body identity between them.
N22 canonical Story Shot is not a generation image for Candidate 02 and must not be used as direct pixel input.
Warm low-key interior must dominate. Exterior light remains a small controlled frame-left cue; no white portal, broad floor-light band, glossy reflection strip, or exterior-dominant frame.
No backpack, shoulder bag, handbag, luggage, travel bag, crossbody strap, or ambiguous bag-like foreground object.
A06 remains later payoff: Neil must not leave/close the door; Guang Yong must not become an explicit speaking beat.
Before any later generation, Work must revalidate Bundle V002 5/5 exact match. Any SHA / byte / Git blob / manifest verification failure means STOP / DO NOT GENERATE.
